raw.title: chore(deps): bump respec from 37.3.0 to 37.3.1
raw.body:

Release notes

Sourced from respec's releases.

v37.3.1

  • fix(a11y): name the modal close button and MDN engine icons for AT by @​marcoscaceres in speced/respec#5206
